title: If that is what he meant, why did he say…
text: If that is what he meant, why did he say something else?
speaker: LibriTTS-R speaker 116 (CC BY 4.0)

packet.format: ACB v2, operating point R4 (small base profile, P4 prosody, K=4096 speaker codebook)

audio_note.ours: our decoder: packet -> gestures -> body -> hyb14 ckpt 958,600: our body's 14-channel motor input + 300 b/s native waveform residual + excitation quant:2,25,4 (vuv, periodicity, 4 noise bands at 25 Hz) from the encoder's audio + native F0/loudness + continuous speaker embedding (about 1 kb/s of side stream on top of the ~92 b/s plan)
audio_note.ours_tv8: no-load plan through the load vocoder (g_tv8 ckpt 1,006,600 fed native (unquantised) F0/loudness and the continuous 64-d speaker embedding; reads only the TV8 projection of the loaded body (tongue sensors, lip aperture, lip protrusion), nothing of the original waveform); the reference inside the loads panel
audio_note.loads: load clips: same packet, body under the load (reflexes on = ExecFM + LAW3, off = springs only), g_tv8 ckpt 1,006,600 fed native (unquantised) F0/loudness and the continuous 64-d speaker embedding; reads only the TV8 projection of the loaded body (tongue sensors, lip aperture, lip protrusion), nothing of the original waveform
